notes.title: 🤖 Break-a-bot final update!
notes.notes:
[p]🆕 [b]What’s New:[/b]
👊 [b]Zippy’s Got Arms![/b] – Zippy now starts with his own fists, punch your way to your first upgrade, or try finishing the game with just those for a Steam achievement
🏆 [b]Steam Achievements[/b] – how many can you get?
💥 [b]Improved VFX[/b] – Punchier, clearer, and more satisfying visuals
⚔️ [b]Combat Tweaks & Balancing[/b] – Tighter, smoother fights all around
🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes[/b] – Tons of them, thanks to your reports[/p][p]While this is our final content update, we’ll still be around in [b]Discord[/b] if you need help or want to share feedback.[/p][p][i]Break-a-bot[/i] was created as a student project, and since we’ve wrapped up our studies, we won’t be continuing regular development.[/p][p]Thanks again for playing, supporting us, and being part of the Break-a-bot journey ❤️[/p]

notes.title: 💥 Break-a-bot – New Update Available! 🤖
notes.notes:
[p]🆕 [b]What’s New:[/b]
💥 [b]Destructible Objects[/b] – Tear through the environment and watch the world react
👹 [b]New Boss Fight[/b] – A brutal new enemy stands in your way
⚠️ [b]Environmental Hazards[/b] – Traps, dangers, and surprises around every corner
🎥 [b]Updated Camera System[/b] – Smoother tracking and improved gameplay feel[/p][p]As always, your feedback keeps the gears turning — let us know what you think, and stay tuned for more updates soon![/p]

notes.title: 🎉Break-a-bot – Full release is here!
notes.notes:
[b]Full Release Celebration – Break-a-bot is Out Now![/b]

Break-a-bot is finally here! After a couple of busy weeks adding content, fixing things up, and making it all feel great, the full version is ready to play — and it’s packed with more action, more polish, and more fun than ever.

[b]🔥 What’s New:[/b]
🗡️ New weapons to master
💥 More action-packed encounters
🌄 Improved environments and visuals
👹 Smarter, tougher enemies
⚙️ Smoother gameplay and refined systems

Jump in, give it a go, and let us know what you think — your feedback helps us keep making the game better!
